goal: 成功点到咖啡,满意离开

n1.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
n1.line: Good morning! What can I get for you? The machine is still heating up, so please wait a moment.
n1.lineCn: 早上好!您想要点什么?咖啡机还在预热,请稍等一会儿。

grammar.name: 现在进行时表进行
grammar.note: The machine is heating up. be + doing 表示此刻正在进行的动作。

options.text: I am having a latte and a croissant, please.
options.textCn: 请给我一杯拿铁和一个可颂。
options.feedback: 用现在进行时表达了想要的饮品,还点了小食,点餐清晰。
太笼统,工作人员不知道具体要哪种咖啡。
答非所问,这不是在问候你,而是在问你要点什么。

n2.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
n2.line: A latte and a croissant! The croissant is being warmed in the oven. What size would you like?
n2.lineCn: 一杯拿铁和一个可颂!可颂正在烤箱里加热。您要大杯还是小杯?

grammar.name: 被动语态的进行时
grammar.note: The croissant is being warmed. be being + 过去分词表示"正被加热"。

options.text: A large one, please. And is it being made right now?
options.textCn: 请来大杯。现在正在做吗?
options.feedback: 回答了尺寸,还用现在进行时追问进度,非常自然。
没有回答尺寸问题,点单信息不完整。

options.text: I am not sure. What is the price?
options.feedback: 没有先确定尺寸就问价格,店员的点单流程被打断。

n3.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
n3.line: I see... We have Americano, latte, cappuccino and mocha. What are you thinking of having?
n3.lineCn: 明白了……我们有美式、拿铁、卡布奇诺和摩卡。您想喝哪一种呢?

grammar.name: What are you thinking of having?
grammar.note: 现在进行时表示"正打算",后接动名词,询问当下想法。

options.text: I am thinking of having a mocha, please.
options.feedback: 用 I am thinking of... 说出具体选择,对话回到正轨。

options.textCn: 随便。给我来点什么就行。
options.feedback: 态度敷衍,店员无法确认你到底想要什么。

n4.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
n4.line: Yes, the milk is being steamed right now. That will be 28 yuan. Are you paying by card?
n4.lineCn: 是的,牛奶正在打奶泡。一共 28 元。您刷卡支付吗?

grammar.name: be being + 过去分词
grammar.note: The milk is being steamed. 强调"此刻正被加热",由正在进行加被动构成。

options.text: Sure, here is my card. I am waiting for my drink near the window.
options.textCn: 好的,这是我的卡。我在窗边等着取咖啡。
options.feedback: 顺利付款并告知等候位置,全程礼貌清晰。

options.text: I do not have money today.
options.feedback: 点了餐却付不了款,场面尴尬。

options.text: Can I pay later? I am really in a hurry now.
options.textCn: 我能晚点再付吗?我现在真的很赶时间。
options.feedback: 在店里要求赊账很不合适,让店员为难。

n5.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
n5.line: No problem. A medium latte is 24 yuan, and a large one is 28. Which one are you getting?
n5.lineCn: 没问题。中杯拿铁 24 元,大杯 28 元。您要哪一种呢?

grammar.name: Which one are you getting?
grammar.note: get 用现在进行时表示"打算购买",常用于点单时的确认。

options.text: I am getting a large one, please.
options.feedback: 明确了尺寸,点单信息完整了。

options.text: I am changing my mind. I do not want coffee anymore.
options.textCn: 我改主意了,不想要咖啡了。
options.feedback: 反复改主意,让店员无所适从。

success.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
success.line: Here is your latte and croissant. Enjoy! Have a nice day!
success.lineCn: 您的拿铁和可颂好了。请慢用!祝您愉快!

fail1.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
fail1.line: Okay... maybe you need a moment to decide. I will serve the next customer first.
fail1.lineCn: 好吧……也许您需要时间考虑一下。我先给下一位顾客点单了。

fail2.speaker: 咖啡师 Barista
fail2.line: I am sorry, but I cannot give you the drink without payment. Please come back another time.
fail2.lineCn: 抱歉,没有付款我不能把饮品给您。请您下次再来吧。
